notes: Partition verified: all 39 source ids and all 44 target ids occur exactly once across the 37 units. Three source tokens are unrepresented — s013 (עַל before the bare English object *any man*, rule 40), s018 (the resumptive suffix beside the rendered אֲשֶׁר, rule 22) and s033 (the attributive's agreement article beside the one written *the*, rule 47) — and nothing is added.

s010+s011 (לְמַשְׁחִית → *utterly*) is a fixed expression rendered by one English word and fuses under rule 30, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme; the margin's literal *to destruction* corroborates the expression without changing the unit.
s036+s037 (לִפְנֵי → *were before*) is rule 30's cited fusion, the construction-supplied copula joining the whole rendering rather than any one morpheme.

The substantival heads at s001, s002 and s006 all apply rule 31's subtraction rather than reaching for the English phrase's noun; s002 (*young man*) and s006 (*little children*) are the closest calls and both notes name the competing reading, which is what rule 8 requires. I let them stand: rule 31 expressly forbids moving a head onto a generic noun merely because it is the noun.

s017 takes *upon* with the copula of its prepositional predicate under rule 49, headed on the preposition, and is discontinuous around the relative *whom* under rule 25; s022 keeps the phrasal *near* with *come* under rule 44.
